subject: Physics
axis_note: Single-rung owner-approved question-demand extension. It is deliberately non-default and does not participate in ordinary Grade-9 NLM progression.

must_contain: One chosen emitted item/body and inertial frame.
A stated time interval or item rate converting momentum to average force.

controlled_variation.notice: average momentum-transfer force changes in direct proportion
average force changes in direct proportion and recoil direction follows the opposite interaction

family.invariant_demand: Choose the item/body and frame, compute per-item momentum change, convert it to a per-time transfer, and assign the recoil partner to the other body.
family.difficult_move: Recognizing that momentum itself is not force: the missing decision is the time/rate conversion.
family.independent_check: The final expression has force units, scales linearly with item rate, and places equal-and-opposite recoil on the launcher.

support_ladder.handed_over: Per-item momentum change and item rate are stated.
Mass, initial/final velocity and item rate are stated; learner forms Delta p.
Only the repeated-emission physical story and requested holding/recoil force are supplied.
